title: CAD incident records for 10 specified June 2024 CAD numbers
summary:
Asks the San Mateo Police Department for the CAD incident record for each of ten specified CAD incidents from June 2024: 202406080025, 202406100006, 202406120022, 202406160190, 202406170170, 202406180016, 202406180026, 202406180224, 202406250013, and 202406260135.

For each incident, it asks for the call type, the date and time received, the location (block level is sufficient), the disposition, and any assigned case number.

The request excludes the name, date of birth, driver's license number, address, phone number, and license plate of any member of the public, including persons listed in a CAD record, and says those may be withheld without further review. It states that none of the numbers came from any City production.

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection ... after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law
policy_promises.tests: Whether the call type, time received, block-level location, disposition, and any case number are released for each listed incident, with the excluded personal identifiers removed.
